paths.naming: Binary user_settings.bin, keyboard-bindings.bin, recent_games.txt and per-controller <name>-bindings.bin files; use the runtime SDL path

Raw host-endian int32_t[64*2] (512 bytes; little-endian on supported desktop hosts): key slots then analog slots; button indices are raw, axis values carry 1<<17/1<<18, hats carry 1<<16|(hat<<8)|SDL_HAT_*; controller name is the file identity and SDL GUID is runtime-only
